'''Joey Sotille''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[March 2001 Fitchburg Sealed Deck tournament (31 March)]] on 31 March 2001, according to Kris Earle's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2199">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-30-3-31-2001-joes-fitchburg-sealedd2199/ 3-31-2001-joes-fitchburg-sealed], DeckTech (Kris "Figgiedan" Earle, 30 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-30-3-31-2001-joes-fitchburg-sealedd2199/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
